title: Local Refinement Around Round 1 Optimum with ±5 nm Bounds
scientific_hypothesis: The Round 1 best candidate (target_score 0.8460) represents a local optimum; restricting search to ±5 nm neighborhood with reduced step-sizes will recover or exceed this performance by fine-tuning spectral features without escaping the basin of attraction.
design_principle: Preserve the 14-layer HfO2/SiO2 alternating topology from Round 1 best candidate. Apply gradient-based optimization with tight thickness bounds (±5 nm from initialization) and reduced learning rate (0.01) to enable fine spectral tuning while preventing the extreme thickness jumps observed in later iterations.
proposed_topology: Air | [HfO2 | SiO2] × 7 | Fused Silica substrate (14 finite layers total, alternating high-low index starting with HfO2)
design_variables: Layer thicknesses (14 variables, bounded ±5 nm from Round 1 best candidate values)
manufacturing_considerations: ±5 nm tolerance represents tight but achievable control for space-grade deposition
theory_basis: Quarter-wave dielectric stack principle for high-reflection bands
Gradient-based local optimization for fine spectral tuning
expected_advantages: Prevents extreme thickness jumps that degraded later iterations
known_risks: May converge to same local optimum without improvement
±5 nm bounds may be too restrictive for global improvement
execution_request_english: Optimize a 14-layer planar dielectric stack on Fused Silica substrate with Air incident medium. Layer sequence: HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2 (alternating, starting with HfO2). Initialize thicknesses at [155.55, 154.35, 153.44, 139.69, 157.86, 125.30, 113.51, 115.26, 154.28, 123.71, 114.88, 122.42, 155.0, 154.0] nm (Round 1 best candidate values, extended to 14 layers). Apply hard bounds of ±5 nm from initialization for each layer. Use gradient_thickness optimizer with learning rate 0.01 and maximum 500 iterations. Evaluate transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band and reflectance in 400-700 nm band at normal incidence, unpolarized. Maximize combined objective score. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 1530-1565 nm, 400-700 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band; High reflectance in 400-700 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band; Low transmittance in 400-700 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Maximum 30 layers.
revision_reason: Re-initializes from Round 1 best candidate with ±5 nm bounds and reduced learning rate per feedback directive to prevent extreme thickness jumps observed in iterations 5 and 10.
